claim_fixture.text: Traceable source lineage makes later review and correction easier to reconstruct.
Faster drafting does not remove the need to preserve provenance and human review.
Publication authority remains a separate decision from draft quality.

headline: Why evidence lineage matters when professional work moves faster

source_fixture.citation: Mokoena, T. (2024). Evidence lineage in professional decision systems. Journal of Applied Governance, 12(2), 44-61.
Naidoo, P. (2025). Human authority in AI-assisted professional workflows. Review of Digital Practice, 8(1), 15-29.
